rows.message: Assertion agent_channel_facts/toplevel_dir_symlink_is_not_caught: exit 0, expected 0 -- The gotchas carries the guard's LIMIT as well as its reach: recreating a TOP-LEVEL directory symlink is not caught, only a relative target whose parent chain already contains a symlink.
